verdict.rationale: Ironclad publishes a first-party API reference with per-endpoint pages (for example create, list, retrieve and update webhook) and guides containing worked REST API examples. Nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive or that its examples can be run in the browser, and the OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it console, runnable examples executed from the docs, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
